_comment: ARCH-V4-A5.5 privileged-function security baseline (Demo). Consumed by scripts/ci/privfn-guard.mjs to prevent future migrations from silently reintroducing broad privileged execution. Static scan — no DB credentials required. See docs/security/PRIVILEGED_FUNCTION_BASELINE.md.

publicAnonExecuteAllowlist.reason: RLS USING predicate for 4 audit policies (ach_read/acc_read/avr_read/pia_read). Evaluated as the querying role, so anon/authenticated/service_role must retain EXECUTE for policy evaluation. Does not read chain-data tables directly; enforces scope. Removing the grant would break RLS reads. Governed exception (Authority §11.1).

rules.denyPublicOrAnonGrantOnFunction: Migrations after baselineMigrationVersion must not GRANT EXECUTE on any function to PUBLIC or anon unless the function is in publicAnonExecuteAllowlist.
rules.requireSearchPathOnNewSecurityDefiner: Any CREATE [OR REPLACE] FUNCTION ... SECURITY DEFINER introduced after baselineMigrationVersion must pin an explicit SET search_path.
rules.note: Grandfathers all pre-baseline migration history; governs future privileged exposure only.
